name: Connected agent (A2A)
summary: Caller agent that delegates to a remote agent via RemoteA2A connection.
description: Creates a caller agent with a RemoteA2A tool / connection pointing at another agent's endpoint. The caller's orchestrator model can be BYOM-routed; the callee is configured independently. Validates that the cross-agent protocol does not strip the BYOM prefix.
notes: Skips with ::warning:: if A2A_REMOTE_AGENT_ENDPOINT is unset. Not in the official supported-tools list.
